sheet_meta.name: Bramble Idle/Waiting Pose
sheet_meta.notes: Full-body landscape idle/waiting pose showing Bramble at her counter. Calm, patient, friendly demeanor. Silent, no mouth movement, no dialogue. Trimmed talking frames (1-9); kept idle frames 10-45 as 1-36. Firefly generation with magenta background removed via connected-component chroma-key.
